function.name: list_services
function.description: List the service names, one-line descriptions and durations the workshop offers, plus the add-ons that can be added to a booking. Always call this before describing a service or offering an add-on; the catalogue is owner-editable and changes. The price ranges in this result are for orientation only and include no add-ons: never say a price from this result aloud — always call get_price_quote for the figure you quote.
